Say goodbye to resource-heavy, Electron-bloated word processors! 🚀 

WordCraft is an ambitious clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word written in pure Rust, delivering native cross-platform performance without the overhead. 

The Problem: Traditional desktop document editors are notoriously sluggish, consume massive amounts of RAM, and lack modern programmatic interfaces for automation and AI integration. 

Enter WordCraft. Built with a GPU-accelerated egui UI framework, it offers lightning-fast text rendering, layout caching, and robust support for .docx, .odt, .rtf, HTML, and Markdown—rendering pages on demand and exporting seamlessly to PDF. 

🔥 Key Developer Features:
• Zero Electron/Tauri bloat: Written entirely in pure Rust for blazing-fast performance.
• Deep Feature Parity: Includes a ribbon interface, live styles, track changes, comment balloons, mail merge, and advanced reference tools.
• Embeddable Engine: Use it as a robust Rust library or CLI utility for headless, high-scale document conversion pipelines.
• Built-in AI Agent Support: Features a unified command infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, allowing autonomous AI agents to drive the UI, CLI, and JSON control channels natively.

Whether you are building headless server-side document pipelines or looking for a blueprint to expose complex desktop apps to AI agents, WordCraft is your go-to engine. 

Check out the repository, drop a star, and start building today:
https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft

What will you build with a lightning-fast, AI-ready document processor in Rust? Let us know in the comments below! 👇

Want to run modern NVIDIA RTX GPUs on macOS 15 Sequoia? 🖥️🔥

For years, NVIDIA users have been locked out of the latest macOS releases due to a lack of native driver support. But that changes now. 

NullMoth has built an incredible open-source graphics translation pipeline that brings modern NVIDIA GeForce RTX cards (Turing, Ampere, Ada Lovelace, and Blackwell series) directly to macOS 15 Sequoia on Intel and OpenCore-configured hardware. 🚀

Here is the problem it solves:
It bridges the gap between Apple's proprietary graphics stack and powerful discrete NVIDIA hardware by implementing a comprehensive Metal-to-Vulkan driver stack and open-source kernel extensions. 

Notable Features:
⚡ Complete Metal 3 hardware feature implementation, including argument buffers tier 2, ray tracing, mesh shaders, and MetalFX paths.
🔄 Custom shader translation layer mapping Apple AIR to SPIR-V, coupled with Mesa NVK and the NAK compiler.
🖥️ Integration with NVIDIA open-source GSP GPU kernel modules (r610) for native display and acceleration via WindowServer.
🛠️ Automated deployment via the companion 1401 Mac app, handling OpenCore config, crash reporting, and a one-click rollback mechanism.

Whether you are a Hackintosh power user, a cross-platform graphics developer, or an AI researcher looking to harness high-performance NVIDIA horsepower inside the macOS ecosystem, this repository is a goldmine. Systems engineers will also find it to be a rare, working blueprint for bridging proprietary hardware with Apple's modern graphics stack.

👇 Check out the project, explore the source code, and drop a star to support open-source hardware hacking:
https://github.com/nullmoth/nvidia-macos-driver

Tired of handing your most sensitive financial data over to third-party SaaS aggregators just to see your net worth? 

Take full control of your wealth with Aurelio, a local-first personal finance tracker powered by an optional AI advisor that keeps your financial data strictly on your own machine.

Aurelio solves the privacy and fragmentation problems of modern personal finance by providing a self-hosted wealth management platform that aggregates your bank accounts, brokerages, real assets, and debts into a single, private SQLite database.

Here is what makes it a must-have for your homelab:
🔒 Local-First Architecture: All your records live securely in a local SQLite file, complete with automated backups before any format changes.
📊 Advanced Portfolio Analytics: Enjoy multi-market asset pricing, deep look-through analysis of fund holdings by country, sector, and company, and clear cash flow visualization.
🤖 Optional AI Advisor: Powered via OpenRouter, the agent operates directly on your records, handles web searches, and proposes structured changes using explicit confirmation cards.
⚡ Modern Tech Stack: Built with modern Python tooling using Astral uv for the backend and a Node.js-powered frontend with hot-reload capabilities.

For developers and self-hosters, Aurelio serves as a clean reference implementation for building local-first web apps that combine complex backend data processing with modern LLM function calling and agentic workflows.

Deploy your private wealth tracking dashboard today and experiment with agentic workflows that read from a private database and propose verified structural changes.

Check out the repository here:
https://github.com/LosaLosSantos/aurelio-finance

Tired of waiting on sluggish local searches when trying to navigate massive codebases? 

Achieve 1-millisecond whole-disk file searches and indexed grep across 8 million files on macOS with this high-performance Rust search tool.

FSearch solves the developer pain point of slow, clumsy desktop indexing by combining an initial fast disk crawl via native macOS APIs with real-time updates through FSEvents. It provides sub-millisecond file name lookups and rapid indexed content searching through either a CLI daemon or an embeddable Rust crate.

Here is what makes it a game-changer for your local workflow:

⚡ Blazing Speed: Delivers roughly 1ms p50 latency for whole-disk file name searches and about 9ms latency for content grep across nearly 8 million files.
🔍 Advanced Query Syntax: Supports fuzzy matching with typo forgiveness, prefix/suffix filters, regex pattern matching, and metadata filters like size, extension, modification time, and directory constraints.
🧠 Efficient Architecture: Utilizes a memory-mapped file for name storage laid out folder-by-folder, alongside a trigram index for text files that reads fresh content directly from disk to prevent staleness.
🔌 Flexible Integration: Use it via a background CLI daemon with a JSON lines IPC socket, a stdio mode, or as a native Rust crate API.

Whether you are integrating the daemon into your custom terminal workflows or embedding the crate into internal developer utilities, FSearch transforms disk navigation into a near-instant operation.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/noahdunnagan/fsearch

Drop a comment below if you are ready to speed up your local development setup, and share this with a fellow dev who hates waiting on slow search tools!

Tired of your macOS desktop turning into a chaotic dumping ground every time you snap a bug report or UI screenshot? 

Meet Tendedero—a delightful, native macOS utility that reimagines screenshot workflows by hanging recent captures like laundry on a line just beneath your menu bar. 🧺✨

The Problem:
Every time you take a screenshot, it either litters your desktop or triggers those annoying floating thumbnails that get in the way. Tendedero intercepts new screenshots and displays them in a minimalist, physics-simulated line accessible by hovering near the top of your screen. 

Why you will love it:
👉 Instant Actions: Click to copy, press-and-hold for system Markup, double-click for Preview, or drag-and-drop straight into Jira, GitHub, or Slack.
👉 Ultra-Lightweight: Built purely in Swift, AppKit, and SwiftUI with a binary size of just 1.7 MB, zero network access, and complete privacy.
👉 Smart Integration: Automatically restores your default screenshot settings when you quit and hides itself during fullscreen app usage.

For Developers:
Beyond being a massive productivity boost for tech creators and power users, Tendedero is an incredible open-source reference for advanced macOS native development. Dive into the codebase to study clean separation of concerns, custom SwiftUI and AppKit transparent window panels, global shortcut monitoring, and programmatic asset generation scripts. 💻🚀

Check out the repo, drop a star, and clean up your workflow today:
https://github.com/alejandrobujan/tendedero
